title: Replace app logo with user-provided image

requirements.text: Replace the current app logo with the user-provided VoiceMate logo image (ChatGPT Image Feb 22, 2026, 06_42_56 PM.png) throughout the application
acceptanceCriteria: The uploaded VoiceMate logo image replaces the existing logo in the landing page hero section
The uploaded VoiceMate logo image replaces the existing logo in the AppLayout header
Logo image is properly sized and styled to fit the existing layout design
Logo image displays correctly in both light and dark themes

requirements.text: Render the generated logo image as a static asset from frontend/public/assets/generated without routing through the backend
acceptanceCriteria: Logo image is served from frontend/public/assets/generated directory
Logo image loads correctly on initial page render
No backend endpoints are used for serving the logo image

constraints: Do not modify the backend for image serving
Do not alter the frontend/src/hooks directory files
Do not modify the frontend/src/components/ui directory files

required: VoiceMate app logo with microphone, notification bell, and speech bubble design in blue-to-green gradient colors with text 'VoiceMate Your Personal Organizer' (voicemate-logo.dim_800x800.png)
